text:
Eva: quick q — for the routing-policy rollout export, what do we include as 'actor' by default? full user id, email, service name?
Josh: we promised 'who changed what' to SOC. they want an immutable actor id, but product also wants human-readable email. maybe both with a PII/redaction mode.
Mei: agree. could we include actor_id + actor_display (nullable) and an export_mode flag? consumers can request pseudonymized exports.
Anita: concern: duplicates across tenants if we use global actor ids. need tenant-scoped actor mapping in the export bundle.
compliance-bot: Reminder: retention policy — infra changes 7y, user-side changes 1y. See https://redwood.internal/compliance/audit-retention :clipboard: 
Josh: quick schema idea (ndjson):
```ndjson
{ "ts": 1719950001, "actor_id": "u:12345", "actor_display": "alice@org.com", "actor_type": "user", "tenant": "t:abc", "change": {"old": "route:stable","new": "route:beta-12"}, "rollout_id": "r:2024-11-11-1" }
```
Eva: add `justification` (console reason prompt) and `rollout_link`/`rollout_id` so downloads can map to a rollout timeline.
Mei: export size worry — including actor_display for every event explodes bundle size. propose: events.ndjson uses actor_id only; actors.json maps id -> display (optional).
Anita: +1. bundle structure = `manifest.json` + `events.ndjson` + `actors.json` (+ signatures). actors.json can be compressed or pseudonymized per tenant policy.
Josh: telemetry: emit metrics `audit_export_size_bytes`, `audit_events_count`, and `actor_display_ratio` so Optimize can suggest toggles.
Eva: UX: console should show a compact preview (5 sample rows) before download with PII masked and a toggle to show raw. preview should explain what will be in the full bundle.
Anita: edge cases: SSO-linked identities vs service principals. add `actor_type` enum: `user|svc|system` and `actor_source` (sso, local, api-key).
Mei: security note: include `manifest.signed_by` and `manifest.signature` (detached) so customers verify bundle integrity; record signing key id in telemetry.
compliance-bot: Action: please add legal review. @Denise (Legal) can confirm what we can surface in actors.json for exports across jurisdictions.
Anita: I'll draft PR with schema + bundle example and console preview mock by EOD. ping @Josh for telemetry counters and @Mei for signing details.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-export-service v1.3 -> staging at 1719951200 :rocket:
Josh: one more — add an `export_mode` header: `full|pseudonymized|minimal` so downstream consumers know contract.
Eva: sounds good. let's keep default to `pseudonymized` for self-serve downloads and allow `full` only for enterprise / contract endpoints. :white_check_mark:
